facts.text: Audrey expressed that animals bring joy and she cannot imagine life without them.

evidence.quote: Animals are great! They really bring so much joy. Can't imagine life without them!

facts.text: Andrew acknowledged that not everyone shares the appreciation for animals that Audrey and he do.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I'm glad we both appreciate them. Not everyone feel this way.

facts.text: Audrey stated that she does not understand why some people hate or harm pets, considering them like family.

evidence.quote: I don't really get some people hating on pets or even hurting them. They're like family to people.

facts.text: Andrew shared an image of a flower bed with many different colored flowers in his neighborhood park.

evidence.quote: Take a look at this park in my neighborhood that has these flowers. [image: a photography of a flower bed with many different colored flowers]
